text: AI infrastructure · updated daily What one GPU-hour costs to rent, in US dollars, by GPU model and provider. Prices of 11 November 2026. Compute only: storage and data transfer cost extra (for Vast.ai, see below ). Hover a price for the instance it comes from. * = source not updated today; last price shown. Each Vast.ai host sets its own charge for data sent to and from the machine, billed per GB on top of the hourly price. Most charge little, but some charge US$30 or more per TB in each direction, which can outweigh a lower hourly price when large datasets or model weights are moved. Charges of the same day's offers, in US$ per TB (1 TB = 1,000 GB). Highest and US$30+ count the dearer direction of each offer. The hourly price includes a small default disk; more disk is charged per GB-month. AWS and Azure charge for data sent out to the internet: see AWS data transfer and Azure bandwidth pricing. Daily since 02 November 2026. Generated 2026-11-11 15:17.
